values.note: All nine sites are reservable on recreation.gov; 'Availability is extremely limited during weekends and holidays.' Run by the concessionaire Naventure. Check-in after 2 pm, check-out by noon; 2 tents and 2 vehicles per site, a third vehicle $5 paid on site.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10293122 (notices: 'This campground is managed by the Naventure', check-in/out, 'Limit 2 tents and 2 vehicles per site; $5 additional vehicle fee collected on-site') + RIDB catalog (9 reservable sites), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Pisgah NF (Pisgah Ranger District), a former logging camp on NC-215 by the West Fork Pigeon River; one row of sites with gravel tent pads, run by the concessionaire Naventure. Small RVs only (short undeveloped pull-ins; a 23-ft rig fits, big rigs do not). Black bear territory: smellable items locked in a vehicle or camper. --Claude
summary: Open in 2026 (recreation.gov calendar shows bookings through Oct), concession-run by Naventure; no Helene or NC-215 alert on the NFsNC alerts page. Confirmed $25 (FS page + 2026 rate table), no hookups, flush toilets, no showers stated. Changed season to Mar 23 - Nov 15 (recreation.gov notice), added 9 sites in one row (no pull-throughs), reservable on recreation.gov. Drinking water left as recorded (false): the FS page says 'Potable water is not available' while recreation.gov's site attributes list 'Drinking Water'. Not stated: max rig length, fcfs, minimums (no facility rules).
flags: Phone: the entry's 828-877-3265 is not on either page. The campground's own number (Naventure staff, March 23 - November 15) is 828-577-4910; the Pisgah Ranger District office now lists (828) 866-3437.
